topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Odyssey Finance. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 91 contract row(s) across base, ethereum, optimism. Structural roles: 67 core, 17 unclassified, 4 supporting, 3 infra. 28 row(s) use upgradeable patterns.
